submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE transparent game sprite, mountain guardian boy run S frame 15. Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET for head, upperbody, held objects and canvas layout. Image 2 is the SAME LEFT-foot earlier support example for identity of planted leg and grounded boot; do not copy its stance. Image 3 committed identity, image 4 same-direction idle, image 5 polished bright Q-art material style only, ignore UI.
CRITICAL ACTION CHANGE: LEFT foot must CONTINUE to bear weight. RIGHT foot is the swinging leg. Original target incorrectly has both feet airborne; replace that with one real support foot on invisible ground. POSITION STAGE 4, frame 1 of the two distinct trailing support poses. The SAME support foot reaches the last posterior ground position, slightly farther behind the pelvis than stage 3, heel lifts a little, but forefoot still bears weight firmly on ground; opposite knee is ahead with boot airborne. There must be continuous visible rear-foot contact, not both feet airborne. This is not an aerial pose.
South/toward-camera projection. Supporting LEFT leg stays on its anatomical side (screen-right), boot points toward camera with NO horizontal splay. Ground position retreats in DEPTH (slightly upward on canvas), not sideways: the LEFT support sole around 89–91% of canvas height, with opposite advancing boot near camera but still above its future forward ground. Adjust only the actual knee/shin/ankle/boot anatomy to reach this depth; perspective back ground is higher on screen. Keep natural thigh separation, not rigid sticks or pinched legs.
Preserve image1 face, brown ponytail/green ribbons, eye direction, gold/green armor, beads, ivory pants, boots shape/material, target arm phase, right-hand complete long staff, left-arm round shield, camera, scale, framing and position. Change only necessary hips/knee/shin/ankle/shoes and natural cloth folds. No whole-character translation/scale, no mirror, no duplicate-pose image, no rigid legs, extra limbs, twisted ankles or feet turned outward. Distinct evolving loaded joint angles must show an independent temporal pose within the two-frame position stage. Keep both boots separate and readable. High finish matching target. Genuine transparent background including jade ring aperture. Single square full-canvas RGBA >=1024px, complete staff/ribbons/boots with margins. No ground art, shadows, labels, arrows, grid, collage, or blur.
